name: Telegram Business Brainstorm Bot - Conversation Modes

parameters.query:
WITH mode_row AS (
  INSERT INTO brainstorm_mode (chat_id, thread_id, mode)
  VALUES ($1::bigint, $2::bigint,
          CASE WHEN $3 IN ('brainstorm', 'challenge') THEN $3 ELSE 'normal' END)
  ON CONFLICT (chat_id, thread_id) DO UPDATE SET
    mode = CASE
      WHEN $3 IN ('brainstorm', 'challenge') THEN $3
      WHEN $3 = 'exit' THEN 'normal'
      ELSE brainstorm_mode.mode END,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING mode
), saved AS (
  INSERT INTO brainstorm_messages
    (chat_id, thread_id, message_id, user_id, speaker, role, command, content)
  SELECT $1::bigint, $2::bigint, $4::bigint, $5::bigint, $6, 'user', $7, $8
  WHERE $8 <> '' AND $7 IN ('brainstorm', 'challenge', 'summary', 'discuss')
  ON CONFLICT (chat_id, message_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT mode FROM mode_row) AS active_mode,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saved) AS stored,
       COALESCE(
         (SELECT json_agg(recent ORDER BY recent.created_at, recent.message_id)
          FROM (SELECT speaker, role, content, created_at, message_id
                FROM brainstorm_messages
                WHERE chat_id = $1::bigint AND thread_id = $2::bigint
                  AND message_id <> $4::bigint
                ORDER BY created_at DESC, message_id DESC LIMIT 20) recent),
         '[]'::json
       ) AS history;

INSERT INTO brainstorm_messages
  (chat_id, thread_id, message_id, user_id, speaker, role, command, content)
VALUES ($1::bigint, $2::bigint, $3::bigint, NULL, 'Bot', 'assistant', NULL, $4)
ON CONFLICT (chat_id, message_id) DO NOTHING;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Extract AI reply').first().json.chatId, $('Extract AI reply').first().json.threadId, $json.message_id, $('Extract AI reply').first().json.response ] }}
